description: Canonical legacy component names excluded from the recorder release boundary. Historical source may remain under components/ and charts/fabric/charts/, but release workflows, packaging, and the umbrella chart must not reference them. Consumed by test_recorder_release_boundary.py.

notes.forbidden_chart_names: Helm chart names that differ from their component directory name (the langfuse-bootstrap component shipped a 'langfuse' subchart). Checked in addition to forbidden_components when scanning chart manifests.
